actions.name: CZML Writer
actions.description: Exporta características como CZML para visualización en Cesium, con soporte para entidades dinámicas en el tiempo y posiciones de series temporales

parameterI18n.title: CZML Writer Parameters
parameterI18n.description:
Configuration for writing geographic features to CZML files. Supports both static entities and time-dynamic entities with interpolated position samples.

## Timeseries Configuration

To create time-animated entities in Cesium, configure at least the first two parameters below; configure `epoch` only when using numeric time offsets: 1. `timeField` - Attribute containing time values 2. `groupTimeseriesBy` - Attribute to group features into entities 3. `epoch` (optional) - Base time used when `timeField` contains numeric offsets

### Example with ISO 8601 timestamps: ```yaml - action: CZML Writer with: output: "vehicles.czml" timeField: "timestamp"           # Contains "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", etc. groupTimeseriesBy: "vehicleId"   # Groups by vehicle ID interpolationAlgorithm: "LAGRANGE" interpolationDegree: 5 ```

### Example with numeric time offsets: ```yaml - action: CZML Writer with: output: "sensors.czml" timeField: "timeOffset"          # Contains numeric values: 0, 60, 120, etc. groupTimeseriesBy: "sensorId" epoch: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"    # Base time for offsets interpolationAlgorithm: "LINEAR" ```

colorAttribute.title: Color Attribute
colorAttribute.description: Attribute containing a hex color string (e.g., "#ffd8c0") for polygon fill. Used when polygon geometry is auto-converted from the feature geometry.

epoch.title: Epoch
epoch.description:
Reference time (ISO 8601 format) used as the base for numeric time offsets.

**When to use:** - Optional but recommended when `timeField` contains numeric values (e.g., "0", "60", "3600") - Not needed when `timeField` contains ISO 8601 datetime strings

**Format:** ISO 8601 datetime string with timezone - Examples: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", "2024-06-15T09:00:00+09:00"

**Auto-detection:** If omitted and all time values are numeric, automatically defaults to Unix epoch "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z". For custom time ranges, explicitly set this parameter to your desired base time.

**Example:** ```yaml epoch: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"  # Time value "60" means 2024-01-01T00:01:00Z ```

groupBy.title: Group By Attributes
groupBy.description: Attributes used to group features into separate CZML files

groupTimeseriesBy.title: Group Timeseries By
groupTimeseriesBy.description: Attribute used to group features into a single time-dynamic CZML entity. Features with the same value for this attribute are merged into one packet with time-tagged positions.

heightAttribute.title: Height Attribute
heightAttribute.description: Attribute containing a numeric value for polygon extrusion height. When set, polygons are extruded from ground to this height value.

interpolationAlgorithm.title: Interpolation Algorithm
interpolationAlgorithm.description: Algorithm used by Cesium to interpolate between time-tagged samples.

interpolationDegree.title: Interpolation Degree
interpolationDegree.description: Degree of interpolation (1 for LINEAR, 5 typical for LAGRANGE).

opacity.title: Opacity
opacity.description: Alpha value (0–255) for polygon fill color. Default: 180.

output.title: Output File Path
output.description: Path where the CZML file will be written

timeField.title: Time Field
timeField.description:
Attribute containing the timestamp for each feature. Supports two formats: - **ISO 8601 strings**: e.g., "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", "2024-01-01T12:30:45+09:00" - **Numeric values**: Seconds as offset from epoch (e.g., "0", "60", "120.5")

When set together with `groupTimeseriesBy`, features sharing the same group key are combined into a single CZML entity with time-tagged position samples for animation in Cesium.

**Example workflow configuration:** ```yaml - action: CZML Writer with: output: "output.czml" timeField: "timestamp" groupTimeseriesBy: "vehicleId" epoch: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"  # Optional for numeric times (auto-defaults to Unix epoch) ```

HERMITE.description: Hermite spline interpolation using tangent data.

LAGRANGE.description: Lagrange polynomial interpolation for smooth curves (typical degree 5).

actions.name: Ray Intersector
actions.description: Calcula los puntos de intersección entre rayos y geometrías

parameterI18n.title: Ray Intersector Parameters
parameterI18n.description: Configure how rays and geometries are paired and how intersection results are output.

closestIntersectionOnly.title: Closest Intersection Only
closestIntersectionOnly.description: Whether to keep only the nearest hit per ray rather than every hit along it. Defaults to true.

geomId.title: Geometry ID
geomId.description: Expression evaluated on each geometry feature to label it. When set, every intersection carries a `geom_id` attribute naming the geometry it hit.

includeRayOrigin.title: Include Ray Origin
includeRayOrigin.description: Whether an intersection at the ray's own origin counts as a hit. When false, intersections nearer than the tolerance are discarded. Defaults to true.

outputGeometryType.title: Output Geometry Type
outputGeometryType.description: Geometry to emit for each intersection.

pairId.title: Pair ID
pairId.description: Expression producing the key that pairs rays with geometries, so that only rays and geometries whose keys match are tested against each other. Omit it to test every ray against every geometry.

ray.title: Ray
ray.description: Attributes on the ray features that hold the ray's origin and direction.

tolerance.title: Tolerance
tolerance.description: Distance below which an intersection is treated as coincident with the ray's origin. Defaults to 1e-10.

dirX.title: Direction X Attribute
dirX.description: Attribute holding the X component of the ray's direction.

dirY.title: Direction Y Attribute
dirY.description: Attribute holding the Y component of the ray's direction.

dirZ.title: Direction Z Attribute
dirZ.description: Attribute holding the Z component of the ray's direction.

posX.title: Origin X Attribute
posX.description: Attribute holding the X coordinate of the ray's origin.

posY.title: Origin Y Attribute
posY.description: Attribute holding the Y coordinate of the ray's origin.

posZ.title: Origin Z Attribute
posZ.description: Attribute holding the Z coordinate of the ray's origin.

lineSegmentToIntersection.title: Line Segment to Intersection
lineSegmentToIntersection.description: Emits a line running from the ray's origin to the intersection point.

pointOfIntersection.title: Point of Intersection
pointOfIntersection.description: Emits a point at the location where the ray meets the geometry.

parameterI18n.title: SpatialFilter Parameters
parameterI18n.description: Configure spatial relationship testing between filter and candidate geometries

matchMode.title: Match Mode
matchMode.description: Whether a candidate passes by matching any single filter feature, or only by matching every filter feature.

mergeFilterAttributes.title: Merge Filter Attributes
mergeFilterAttributes.description: If true, copy attributes from matched filter feature(s) onto the candidate. Only applies to features routed to the passed port. In OR mode (pass_on_multiple_matches: true), only the first matching filter's attributes are merged. In AND mode, attributes from all matched filters are merged in order; if multiple filters share a key, the last filter's value wins.

mergedAttributesPrefix.title: Merged Attributes Prefix
mergedAttributesPrefix.description: Optional prefix applied to merged filter attribute names to avoid collisions. For example, a prefix of "filter_" turns a filter attribute "zone" into "filter_zone".

outputMatchCountAttribute.title: Output Match Count Attribute
outputMatchCountAttribute.description: Optional attribute name to store the number of matching filters

predicate.title: Spatial Predicate
predicate.description: The spatial relationship to test between filter and candidate geometries

all.title: All
all.description: Passes a candidate only when every filter feature matches it.

any.title: Any
any.description: Passes a candidate that matches at least one filter feature.

coveredBy.description: Candidate is covered by filter geometry

touches.description: Geometries touch at boundaries but don't overlap

calculations.description: Statistics to compute for each group. Each entry names an output attribute, the aggregation method, and (except for count) the expression whose values are aggregated.

groupBy.title: Group By
groupBy.description: Attributes to group features by before aggregating. When omitted, all input features form a single group.

groupId.title: Group ID
groupId.description: Optional attribute in which to store the group identifier, formed by joining the Group By values with '|'.

aggregation.title: Aggregation Method
aggregation.description: Statistic to compute across each group. Defaults to sum.

expr.title: Value Expression
expr.description: Expression evaluated per feature to produce the value being aggregated. Required for every method except count, which counts features regardless of value.

newAttribute.title: New Attribute Name
newAttribute.description: Name of the output attribute that stores the computed statistic.

count.title: Count
count.description: Counts the number of features in each group. The value expression is not required and is ignored.

max.title: Maximum
max.description: Keeps the largest value of the expression in each group.

mean.title: Mean
mean.description: Averages the value of the expression across all features in each group.

min.title: Minimum
min.description: Keeps the smallest value of the expression in each group.

sum.title: Sum
sum.description: Adds the value expression across all features in each group.
